safe.model

Class SafeModel

  • java.lang.Object
    • GModel
      • safe.model.SafeModel

  • public class SafeModel
extends GModel
    MAIN CLASS for Hi-sAFe List of main methods loadInitStand : load the pld file loadGeneralParameter : load the hisafe and stics general parameters file loadWeather : load the weather file loadExport : load export parameters initializeModel : create and initialize all objects (stand soil voxels plot cells crops trees) projectJustOpened : reopen a saved project processEvolution : simulation loop from dayStart to dayEnd processGrowth : daily loop growth for trees and crop export : create and file export file
